name: Nikaidou Hiro
source:
Excellent academics, well-rounded athletics, and a disguinshed family — a flawless girl in every sense of the world, a "Yamato Nadeshiko". Trusted by all those around her, she held a prominent position in school as well. She has a strong sense of responsibility, something that she takes upon herself with honor. She has a strong value system, consisting of a right sense of 'right' and 'wrong'. This can lead her to a rather close-minded way of thinking. She wishes to see a pure world, untainted by evil. She has a more delicate side to her as well, being rather sentimental with those she holds close to her heart. It seems that she and [url=https://vndb.org/c137420]Ema[/url] had some sort of connection in the past.

Original Sin: Enforcer of Justice.
Magic: ???

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/Hiro_Nikaido]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
[Extended profiles are from the [url=https://https://manosaba.com/]Official Site[/url].]
